claims.quote: It's designed be to be minimal, fast, and easy to set up using Docker.
claims.reason: Contains marketing adjectives ('fast', 'minimal') which are subjective and cannot be verified by a simple browser test.

claims.quote: - Clean UI optimized for readability
claims.check: Open the web app and verify that bookmarks and text are displayed in a clean layout.

claims.quote: - Organize bookmarks with tags
claims.check: Create or edit a bookmark and verify that tags can be added and used for organization.

claims.quote: - Bulk editing, Markdown notes, read it later functionality
claims.check: Select multiple bookmarks to check bulk editing options, verify Markdown note inputs, and look for read-it-later features.

claims.quote: - Share bookmarks with other users or guests
claims.check: Check the bookmark options for sharing features with other users or guests.

claims.quote: - Automatically provides titles, descriptions and icons of bookmarked websites
claims.check: Add a new bookmark with a URL and check if the title, description, and icon are automatically populated.

claims.quote: - Automatically archive websites, either as local HTML file or on Internet Archive
claims.check: Check settings or bookmark creation options for automatic website archiving settings.

claims.quote: - Import and export bookmarks in Netscape HTML format
claims.check: Navigate to the import/export section and verify options to import or export Netscape HTML files.

claims.quote: - Installable as a Progressive Web App (PWA)
claims.check: Check the web app manifest and browser toolbar for PWA installation prompts.

claims.quote: - Extensions for [Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/linkding-extension/) and [Chrome](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/linkding-extension/beakmhbijpdhipnjhnclmhgjlddhidpe), as well as a bookmarklet
claims.check: Verify that a bookmarklet or references to browser extensions are available in the application.

claims.quote: - SSO support via OIDC or authentication proxies
claims.check: Check the login page or settings for OIDC or SSO authentication options.

claims.quote: - REST API for developing 3rd party apps
claims.check: Navigate to the API documentation or endpoint URL and verify that REST API responses are returned.

claims.quote: - Admin panel for user self-service and raw data access
claims.check: Log in as an admin user, navigate to the admin panel, and verify user management and raw data access sections.

claims.quote: The frontend is now available under http://localhost:8000
claims.check: Open http://localhost:8000 in the browser and verify that the application login or home page loads successfully.

claims.quote: The frontend is now available under http://localhost:8000
claims.check: Open http://localhost:8000 in the browser and verify that the application loads successfully inside the DevContainer.

claims.quote: This is the default Django admin app with some linkding specific customizations.
claims.check: A browser test cannot directly inspect Django internals, but can check that the admin interface page loads successfully with linkding-specific branding or elements.

claims.quote: The admin app provides several features that are not available in the linkding UI: - User management and user self-management - Bookmark and tag management, including bulk operations
claims.check: Navigate to the admin app and verify that user management, bookmark management, and tag management sections are present.

claims.quote: To open the Admin app, go the *Settings* view and click on the *Admin* tab.
claims.check: Go to the Settings view in the app, click the Admin tab, and verify that the user is navigated to the admin interface.

claims.quote: This should open a new window with the admin app.
claims.check: Click the Admin tab and verify that a new window or tab opens containing the admin app.

claims.quote: Alternatively you can open the URL directly by adding `/admin` to the URL of your linkding installation.
claims.check: Navigate directly to the base URL appended with `/admin` and verify that the admin login or dashboard page loads.

claims.quote: Go to the linkding administration page and select *Users*.
claims.check: On the admin page, click on *Users* and verify that the user management list is displayed.

claims.quote: Here you can add and delete users, and change the password of a user.
claims.check: On the Users page, check that options to add, delete, and change the password of users are available.

claims.quote: Once you have added a user you can, if needed, give the user staff status, which means this user can also access the linkding administration page.
claims.check: Check that user edit forms include a staff status toggle or checkbox.

claims.quote: This page also allows you to change your own password if necessary.
claims.check: Verify that a password change link or form is present on the user management page.

claims.quote: While the linkding UI itself now has a bulk edit feature for bookmarks you can also use the admin app to manage bookmarks or to do bulk operations.
claims.check: Navigate to the bookmarks section in the admin app and verify bookmark management and bulk operations are available.

claims.quote: In the main linkding administration page, choose *Bookmarks*.
claims.check: On the main admin page, click *Bookmarks* and verify the bookmark list view opens.

claims.quote: In the column *by username*, you can choose to filter for bookmarks for a specific user
claims.check: Check that the filter sidebar or column contains a filter option for username.

claims.quote: In the column *by is archived*, you can choose to filter for bookmarks that are either archived or not
claims.check: Check that the filter sidebar or column contains a filter option for archived status.

claims.quote: In the column *by tags*, you can choose to filter for specific tags
claims.check: Check that the filter sidebar or column contains a filter option for tags.

claims.quote: In the search box you can also add a text filter (note that this doesn't use the same search syntax as the linkding UI itself)
claims.check: Verify that a text search box is present in the bookmark administration view.

claims.quote: Now a list of bookmarks which match your filter is displayed, each bookmark on a separate line.
claims.check: Apply a filter and verify that a list of matching bookmarks is displayed with each item on a separate line.

claims.quote: Each line starts with a checkbox.
claims.check: Verify that every bookmark row in the admin list starts with a checkbox input element.

claims.quote: Either choose the individual bookmarks you want to do a bulk operation on, or choose the top checkbox to select all shown bookmarks.
claims.check: Click individual checkboxes or the master header checkbox and verify that the corresponding rows become selected.

claims.quote: Open the "Action" select box to choose the desired bulk operation: - Delete - Archive - Unarchive
claims.check: Open the Action select dropdown and verify it contains options for Delete, Archive, and Unarchive.

claims.quote: Click the button next to the checkbox to execute the operation.
claims.check: Select a bulk action and click the execution button next to the action dropdown, verifying the action is triggered.

claims.quote: While linkding UI currently only allows to create or assign tags, you can use the admin app to manage your tags.
claims.check: Navigate to the Tags section in the admin app and verify that management interfaces for tags are available.

claims.quote: This can be especially useful if you want to clean up your tag collection.
claims.reason: This is a subjective statement about usefulness and user intent, which cannot be tested by a browser.

claims.quote: In the main linkding administration page, choose *Tags*.
claims.check: On the main admin page, click *Tags* and verify the tag list view opens.

claims.quote: Similar to bookmarks management described above you can now specify which tags to operate on by specifying a filter and then selecting the individual tags.
claims.check: Apply a tag filter and select individual tag checkboxes, verifying they can be checked.

claims.quote: Open the "Action" select box to choose the desired bulk operation: - Delete - Delete unused tags - this will only delete the selected tags that are currently not assigned to any bookmark
claims.check: Open the Action select dropdown on the tags page and verify it contains options to Delete and Delete unused tags.

claims.quote: Click the button next to the checkbox to execute the operation.
claims.check: Select an action in the tags view and click the execution button, verifying the operation runs.

claims.quote: Note that deleting a tag does not affect the bookmarks that are tagged with this tag, it only removes the tag from those bookmarks.
claims.check: Delete a tag attached to a bookmark and verify via the UI that the bookmark itself still exists without that tag.
